newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska fed cattle market inactive - private.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska fed cattle market inactive - private.

text.p: Nebraska feedlot cattle trade was inactive, with most of this week's showlist sold out, market sources said.
"Packers know they can't buy anything today because all the cattle are sold," one Nebraska cattleman said.
Sales this week totalled about 100,000 head at $104.00 to $105.00 per cwt on a dressed basis and up to $65.00 on a live basis. Owners next week were seen pricing cattle at $107.00 and $66.00.
Next week's showlist was expected about steady with this week, which was pegged near 88,000 head, the sources said.
